questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.topic: What a privacy setting actually changes
questions.learningObjective: Identify what a privacy toggle changes
questions.stem: On a transit planner's board, a rider toggles location sharing off and asks what changes.

options.text: Sharing stops but previously collected data may remain
The app keeps collecting but stops displaying the data
options.misconception: assumes collection halts when display stops

options.text: Location data stops being collected entirely by the service

questions.explanation: Turning off sharing limits future visibility but does not erase data already gathered; the tempting idea that it wipes history is wrong.
